title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Denishua WPJAM…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Denishua WPJAM Basic plugin versions up to 7.1.2. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, leading to DOM-based XSS. The flaw can be exploited remotely without privileges but requires user interaction. It impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.
